scripts.script:
-- SERVICES
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local userInput = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local players = game.Players

-- CLEANUP OLD GUI
for _, gui in pairs(player.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
	if gui.Name == "PvPMenuGui" then
		gui:Destroy()
	end
end

-- TOGGLES
local menuOpen = false
local namesEnabled = false
local espEnabled = false
local healthEnabled = false
local MAX_DISTANCE = 150

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PvPMenuGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player.PlayerGui
gui.Enabled = true

local menuFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
menuFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 450)
menuFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, -400)
menuFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
menuFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
menuFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
menuFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
menuFrame.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
corner.Parent = menuFrame

local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20)
scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
scroll.Parent = menuFrame

local uiList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
uiList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
uiList.Padding = UDim.new(0,5)
uiList.Parent = scroll

-- TITLE
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,40)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = "XizHub ESP Universal"
titleLabel.TextScaled = true
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
titleLabel.Parent = scroll

-- BUTTON HELPER
local function makeButton(text)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,40)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	btn.Parent = scroll
	return btn
end

local function updateButtonColor(button, state)
	if state then
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
	else
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
	end
end

-- NAMES BUTTON
local namesButton = makeButton("NAMES")
namesButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	namesEnabled = not namesEnabled
	updateButtonColor(namesButton, namesEnabled)
end)

-- ESP BUTTON
local espButton = makeButton("ESP")
espButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	espEnabled = not espEnabled
	updateButtonColor(espButton, espEnabled)
end)

-- HEALTH BUTTON
local healthButton = makeButton("HEALTH ESP")
healthButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	healthEnabled = not healthEnabled
	updateButtonColor(healthButton, healthEnabled)
end)

-- DISTANCE SLIDER
local distanceLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
distanceLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,30)
distanceLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
distanceLabel.Text = "ESP Distance: "..MAX_DISTANCE
distanceLabel.TextScaled = true
distanceLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
distanceLabel.Parent = scroll

local distanceSlider = Instance.new("TextBox")
distanceSlider.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,30)
distanceSlider.Text = tostring(MAX_DISTANCE)
distanceSlider.TextScaled = true
distanceSlider.ClearTextOnFocus = false
distanceSlider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
distanceSlider.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
distanceSlider.Parent = scroll

distanceSlider.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local val = tonumber(distanceSlider.Text)
	if val then
		MAX_DISTANCE = val
		distanceLabel.Text = "ESP Distance: "..MAX_DISTANCE
	end
end)

uiList:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,uiList.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
end)

-- DISPLAY NAMES
local displayLabels = {}
runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	for _, plr in pairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= player then
			local c = plr.Character
			if c and namesEnabled then
				local rootPart = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if rootPart then
					local playerRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local dist = playerRoot and (rootPart.Position - playerRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
					if dist <= MAX_DISTANCE then
						if not displayLabels[plr] then
							local label = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
							label.Adornee = rootPart
							label.Size = UDim2.new(0,100,0,30)
							label.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3,0)
							label.AlwaysOnTop = true
							label.Parent = player.PlayerGui

							local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
							txt.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
							txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							txt.Text = plr.DisplayName
							txt.TextScaled = true
							txt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
							txt.Parent = label

							displayLabels[plr] = label
						end
					else
						if displayLabels[plr] then
							displayLabels[plr]:Destroy()
							displayLabels[plr] = nil
						end
					end
				end
			elseif displayLabels[plr] then
				displayLabels[plr]:Destroy()
				displayLabels[plr] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- ESP + HEALTH ESP
local highlights = {}
runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	for _, plr in pairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= player then
			local c = plr.Character
			if c then
				local rootPart = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local playerRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if rootPart and playerRoot then
					local dist = (rootPart.Position - playerRoot.Position).Magnitude

					local highlight = highlights[plr]
					if not highlight and espEnabled then
						highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
						highlight.FillTransparency = 1
						highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
						highlight.Parent = c
						highlights[plr] = highlight
					end

					if highlight then
						highlight.Enabled = espEnabled and dist <= MAX_DISTANCE

						if healthEnabled and highlight.Enabled then
							local hum = c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
							if hum then
								local hp = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
								if hp > 0.8 then
									highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
								elseif hp > 0.5 then
									highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0)
								else
									highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
								end
							end
						elseif highlight.Enabled then
							highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- TOGGLE MENU
userInput.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		menuOpen = not menuOpen
		local targetPos
		if menuOpen then
			targetPos = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 50)
		else
			targetPos = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, -400)
		end
		tweenService:Create(menuFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = targetPos}):Play()
	end
end)

-- CLEANUP ON PLAYER LEAVE
players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
	if displayLabels[plr] then
		displayLabels[plr]:Destroy()
		displayLabels[plr] = nil
	end
	if highlights[plr] then
		highlights[plr]:Destroy()
		highlights[plr] = nil
	end
end)

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Name = "WaypointGUI"

--========== DRAGGABLE MAIN FRAME ==========--
local main = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 350)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.3, -150)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
main.Active = true
main.Draggable = true

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,30)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
title.Text = "Waypoint System"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.TextScaled = true

--========== CLOSE BUTTON ==========--
local close = Instance.new("TextButton", main)
close.Size = UDim2.new(0,30,0,30)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1,-35,0,0)
close.Text = "X"
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100,0,0)
close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	gui:Destroy()
end)

--========== TAB BUTTONS ==========--
local tabFrame = Instance.new("Frame", main)
tabFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,30)
tabFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,35)
tabFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local tab1 = Instance.new("TextButton", tabFrame)
tab1.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,0)
tab1.Text = "ButtonTp"
tab1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
tab1.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

local tab2 = Instance.new("TextButton", tabFrame)
tab2.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,0)
tab2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,0)
tab2.Text = "Teleport"
tab2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35)
tab2.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

--========== CONTENT FRAMES ==========--
local content1 = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", main)
content1.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,-70)
content1.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,70)
content1.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,5,0)
content1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,25)

local content2 = Instance.new("Frame", main)
content2.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,-70)
content2.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,70)
content2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,25)
content2.Visible = false

--========== TAB LOGIC ==========--
tab1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	content1.Visible = true
	content2.Visible = false
	tab1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
	tab2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35)
end)

tab2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	content1.Visible = false
	content2.Visible = true
	tab1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35)
	tab2.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
end)

--========== WAYPOINT STORAGE ==========--
local waypoints = {}

for i = 1, 50 do
	waypoints[i] = nil
end

--========== NOTIFICATION FUNCTION ==========--
local function notify(msg)
	game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
		Title = "Waypoint";
		Text = msg;
		Duration = 1;
	})
end

--========== CREATE 50 BUTTONS ==========--
for i = 1, 50 do
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", content1)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, (i-1)*45)
	btn.Text = "TP Button " .. i
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			waypoints[i] = hrp.CFrame
			notify("Clicked!")
		end
	end)
end

--========== TELEPORT ALL BUTTON ==========--
local tpAllBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", content2)
tpAllBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,50)
tpAllBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,10)
tpAllBtn.Text = "Teleport Through All"
tpAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
tpAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

tpAllBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local hrp = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	for i = 1, 50 do
		if waypoints[i] then
			hrp.CFrame = waypoints[i] + Vector3.new(0,2,0)
			notify("TP "..i.."!")
			task.wait(0.8)
		end
	end
end)

scripts.script:
local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
-- yes yiu can change the fonturl just be sure it leads to a direct ttf/otf file 
if not isfile("starborn.ttf") then
    writefile("starborn.ttf", game:HttpGet("https://granny.anondrop.net/uploads/6c2505542959f371/Starborn.ttf"))
end
-- same with weight and style but know what you're doing
writefile("starborn.json", http:JSONEncode({
    name = "Starborn",
    faces = {{name="Regular", weight=400, style="normal", assetId=getcustomasset("starborn.ttf")}}
}))

local myfont = Font.new(getcustomasset("starborn.json"))

-- the roblox icon font we gotta leave alone (this is typically used for textlabels describing images so removing would turn images into texts)
local badfont = tostring(Font.new("rbxasset://LuaPackages/Packages/_Index/BuilderIcons/BuilderIcons/BuilderIcons.json"))

local function donttouch(this)
    if this.TextStrokeTransparency ~= 1 then return false end
    local cur = tostring(this.FontFace)
    return cur == badfont or string.find(cur, "BuilderIcons")
end

local function changeit(txt)
    if txt:IsA("TextLabel") or txt:IsA("TextButton") or txt:IsA("TextBox") then
        if not donttouch(txt) then
            txt.FontFace = myfont
        end
    end
end

-- do everything that exists right now
for _, v in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
    spawn(function() changeit(v) end)
end

-- new stuff
game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
    spawn(function() changeit(obj) end)
end)

end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraType"):Connect(function()
	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Follow then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Follow
	end
end)

local liveFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Live")

local function setupPlayerFolder(folder)
	if folder.Name ~= player.Name then return end

	local bind = folder:FindFirstChild("CutsceneCameraBind")
	if bind then bind:Destroy() end

	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == "CutsceneCameraBind" then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

for _, folder in ipairs(liveFolder:GetChildren()) do
	setupPlayerFolder(folder)
end

liveFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(setupPlayerFolder)

        if not moves[name]:FindFirstChild("SuperArmor") then
            Instance.new("Folder", moves[name]).Name = "SuperArmor"
        end
    end
end

local ts = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ti = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function remove_brightness(color)
    local h,s,v = color:ToHSV()
    return Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 1)
end

plr.Character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
    if v.ClassName:find("Trail") then
        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight", plr.Character.RightHand)
        local fadeout = ts:Create(highlight, ti, {FillTransparency = 1})

        local style = plr.Status.Style.Value
        local style_obj = rep.Styles:FindFirstChild(style)
        local color = style_obj.Color

        highlight.FillColor = color.Value
        highlight.Adornee = v.Parent
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
        highlight.FillTransparency = 1

        ts:Create(highlight, ti, {FillTransparency = 0.2}):Play()

        fadeout.Completed:Once(function()
            highlight:Destroy()
        end)

        v.Destroying:Once(function()
            fadeout:Play()
        end)
    end
end)

local function invuln(YesOrNo)
    if YesOrNo == "Yes" then
        local invul = Instance.new("Folder", status)
        invul.Name = "Invulnerable"
    else
        if status:FindFirstChild("Invulnerable") then
            status.Invulnerable:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

status.ChildAdded:Connect(function(CD)
    wait(0.05)
    if CD.Name == "ANGRY" then
        if status.ANGRY:FindFirstChild("Type") then
            if status.ANGRY.Type.Value == "Resist" then
                invuln("Yes")
            end
        end
    end
end)

status.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(CD)
    if CD.Name == "ANGRY" then
        invuln("No")
    end
end)

local function UpdateStyleColors()
    local colorSequence = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, brawl.Color.Value),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, brawl.Color.Value)
    })
    
    Main.Heat.Fill.ImageColor3 = brawl.Color.Value
    Main.Heat.Fill2.ImageColor3 = brawl.Color.Value
    Main.Heat.ClimaxFill.ImageColor3 = brawl.Color.Value
    Main.Heat.ClimaxFill2.ImageColor3 = brawl.Color.Value
    
    Main.XP.Fill.ImageColor3 = brawl.Color.Value
    
    return colorSequence
end

local function UpdateParticles(colorSequence)
    if not char then return end
    
    local parts = {
        "Fire_Main", "Fire_Secondary", "Lines1", "Lines2", "Sparks", "TimeFor"
    }
    
    for _, partName in ipairs(parts) do
        local part = char.HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild(partName)
        if part then
            if part:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                part.Color = colorSequence
                if partName == "Fire_Main" then
                    part.Rate = status.Heat.Value >= 100 and 115 or status.Heat.Value >= 75 and 85 or 80
                elseif partName == "Fire_Secondary" then
                    part.Rate = status.Heat.Value >= 100 and 90 or status.Heat.Value >= 75 and 80 or 70
                elseif partName == "Lines1" or partName == "Lines2" then
                    part.Rate = status.Heat.Value >= 100 and 60 or status.Heat.Value >= 75 and 40 or 20
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if char.UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("r2f_aura_burst") then
        local aura = char.UpperTorso["r2f_aura_burst"]
        aura.Lines1.Color = colorSequence
        aura.Lines2.Color = colorSequence
        aura.Flare.Color = colorSequence
        aura.Smoke.Color = colorSequence
        
        local showMaxHeat = status.Heat.Value >= 100
        aura.Lines1.Enabled = showMaxHeat
        aura.Flare.Enabled = showMaxHeat
    end
    
    if char.UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("Evading") then
        char.UpperTorso.Evading.Color = colorSequence
    end
end

local colorSeq = UpdateStyleColors()
UpdateParticles(colorSeq)
